summary: A 93 Slayer task done only in the task-only Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars (fairy ring BKP). You must wear a facemask or slayer helmet or their attacks always hit and drain stats; they attack with magical ranged, which Protect from Missiles fully negates. The cave is multicombat, so the usual method is to set a cannon in the centre to lure the devils, stack them behind the piles of remains and barrage them. Players wanting profit can instead kill the Thermonuclear smoke devil boss in its side room.

summary: Rangers (63 Slayer), warriors (68) and mages (83) found only in the God Wars Dungeon and the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, both multicombat areas where nothing can be cannoned. Wear an item for each god whose followers you pass (at least Zamorak plus the god you are killing) so the dungeon stays tolerant, or you will be swarmed. The wiki suggests skipping or blocking rangers, killing warriors in Zamorak's Fortress and mages in Armadyl's Eyrie or the Ancient Prison, the latter being where the dragon boots-dropping mages are most concentrated. Many players block this task because it is slow, not AFKable and drops poorly.
styleNotes: Rangers use Ranged, warriors mostly melee (Armadyl warriors use Ranged, infobox attack style4) and mages Magic; all three infoboxes give elementalweaknesstype Air (30%) for the Zamorak/Saradomin/Bandos/Armadyl variants and Fire (200%) for the Zaros variants; Zamorak mages' Flames of Zamorak drains Magic; Zaros creatures are much stronger; infobox immunecannon = Yes on ranger, warrior and mage.

summary: An unlockable task (Hot stuff, 100 Slayer reward points) from Chaeldar, Nieve or Duradel, done in Mor Ul Rek under the Karamja Volcano. Players normally kill TzHaar-Ket or melee-using TzHaar-Xil because they can be safespotted through the vents, while attacking a Hur or Mej draws the surrounding TzHaar onto you. With a fire cape you can enter the inner city and burst or barrage the level 221 Ket near TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges under Protect from Melee; the master may instead offer TzTok-Jad or TzKal-Zuk as the task.
styleNotes: Hur and Ket use melee (crush), Xil melee or ranged depending on weapon, Mej magic; TzHaar-Ket have a low Magic level and +0 magic defence so they barrage well; a charged ring of wealth improves gem drops; cannons are not allowed.
usefulItems: Ring of wealth (charged) for gem and onyx bolt tip drops
Fire cape (access to the inner city and level 221 Ket)
Ice/Blood Barrage runes and cheap darts for grouping Ket
Prayer potions for Protect from Melee
